description:
Accelerate the possible by joining a winning Amcor team that’s transforming the packaging industry and improving lives around the world. 
 At Amcor, we unpack possibility through our innovative and responsible packaging to provide solutions that benefit our customers, our people and our planet.  More than 10,000 consumers worldwide encounter our products every second and rely on us for safe access to food, medicine and other goods. We value their trust by making safety our guiding principle. It’s our core value and integral to how we do business.
 
Beyond this core principle, our shared values and behaviors unite us as we work together to elevate customers, shape lives and protect the future. We champion our customers and help them succeed. We play to win – adapting quickly in an everchanging world – and make smart choices to safeguard our business, our communities and the people we serve for generations to come. And we invest in our world-class team, empowering our colleagues to unpack their potential, because we believe when our people grow, so does our business.
 
To learn more about playing for Team Amcor, visit  www.amcor.com  I  LinkedIn  I  Glassdoor  I  Facebook   I  YouTube 
 
 
 Job Description 
 Looking for New Grads! 
 We are open to new college graduates with anticipated graduation dates ranging between Dec 2026-Dec 2027 

 
 Description of the program 
 The Amcor EDGE Technical Development Program is a structured two-year rotational program designed to accelerate the development of early-career engineers into future manufacturing and technical leaders within Amcor Flexibles North America.
 Through a combination of formal training, mentorship, hands-on manufacturing experience, and project leadership opportunities, participants will develop a strong foundation in manufacturing processes, problem-solving, continuous improvement, and operational excellence. Engineers in the EDGE Program gain exposure to multiple functions across the organization while building the technical and leadership skills necessary to make an immediate impact within our manufacturing network.
 
 What You Will Do
 Initial Development & Training
 Participate in a structured onboarding and technical development program.

 Receive mentorship and coaching from experienced technical and manufacturing leaders.

 Gain hands-on experience with manufacturing processes, products, equipment, and systems.

 Build analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills through real-world projects and assignments.

 
 Manufacturing & Process Improvement
 Support manufacturing process improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, productivity, and efficiency.

 Assist with identifying operational challenges and evaluating solutions.

 Participate in continuous improvement activities utilizing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Green Belt, and Kaizen methodologies.

 Collect and analyze data to identify opportunities for process optimization.

 Assist with root cause investigations and corrective action implementation.

 
 Project & Technical Support
 Support engineering and capital projects through planning, execution, testing, and implementation activities.

 Coordinate documentation, project materials, and technical information.

 Assist with equipment installation, startup, commissioning, validation, and training activities.

 Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, quality, maintenance, and operations teams to achieve project objectives.

 
 Cross-Functional Development
 Gain exposure to various functional areas across the organization, including Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Research & Development.

 Build relationships across the business to support both technical and professional development.

 Participate in opportunities that strengthen leadership, communication, and project management skills.

 
 Program Structure
 Months 0-6: Manufacturing Foundations
 Participants will develop a strong understanding of manufacturing operations through:
 Safety and GMP training

 Plant visits and facility tours

 Value stream learning

 Manufacturing basics, SOPs, and operational processes

 Operator shadowing experiences

 
 Months 6-12: Process & Product Fundamentals
 Participants will build technical expertise through:
 Material and product training

 ERP and manufacturing systems training

 Continuous Improvement and Kaizen activities

 Green Belt project participation

 Problem-solving methodology training

 Product specification systems training

 
 Months 12-24: Advanced Technical Development
 Participants will further develop expertise through:
 Advanced process knowledge

 Manufacturing best practices

 Troubleshooting complex process issues

 Root cause analysis and corrective action implementation

 Day-to-day operational support and process optimization

 
 Program Completion
 Upon successful completion of the program, participants will transition into a full-time engineering role within the organization and continue development as a technical and operational leader.
 
 Qualifications
 Required Education
 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, including:
 Chemical Engineering

 Mechanical Engineering

 Industrial Engineering

 Materials Science Engineering

 Or a related engineering discipline

 
 Preferred Qualifications
 Prior manufacturing experience through internships, co-ops, research, or industry experience preferred.

 Strong written and verbal communication skills.

 Demonstrated leadership, initiative, and problem-solving abilities.

 Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

 Interest in manufacturing, process improvement, and operational leadership.

 
 What You'll Gain
 Structured two-year technical development program

 Mentorship from experienced manufacturing and engineering leaders

 Hands-on manufacturing experience

 Exposure to cross-functional business operations

 Lean Six Sigma and continuous improvement experience

 Opportunities to lead impactful projects

 Clear pathway to future technical and manufacturing leadership roles within Amcor

 
 Travel Requirements
 Ability to travel up to 30%.

 

 

 
 
 
 Our Expectations 
 We expect our people to be guided by The Amcor Way and demonstrate our Values every day to enable the business to win. We are winning when:
 Our people are engaged and developing as part of a high-performing Amcor team
 Our customers grow and prosper from Amcor’s quality, service, and innovation
 Our investors benefit from Amcor’s consistent growth and superior returns
 The environment is better off because of Amcor’s leadership and products
 
 
 Equal Opportunity Employer/Minorities/Females/Disabled/Veterans/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity 
 Amcor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
 
 If you would like more information about your EEO rights as an applicant under the law, please click on the "Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal" Poster . If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please call 224-313-7000 and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.
 
 
 E-Verify 
 We verify the identity and employment authorization of individuals hired for employment in the United States.
 
 Benefits 
 When you join Amcor, you will have access to a comprehensive benefits and compensation package that includes:
 Medical, dental and vision plans

 Flexible time off, starting at 80 hours paid time per year for full-time salaried employees

 Company-paid holidays starting at 8 days per year and may vary by location

 Wellbeing program & Employee Assistance Program

 Health Savings Account/Flexible Spending Account

 Life insurance, AD&D, short-term & long-term disability, and voluntary benefits

 Paid Parental Leave

 Retirement Savings Plan with company match

 Tuition Reimbursement (dependent upon approval)

 Discretionary annual bonus program (initial eligibility dependent upon hire date)
